runtime_identity.rule: sha256(canonical JSON of boot_id and sorted GPU UUIDs)

selection_policy: The four prepared job identities only; never highest test score.
metric_units: Fractions; Markdown uses percent accuracy and percentage-point forgetting.
audit_scope: Prepared scientific recipe/source/weights, full data identity, unrounded ten-stage records, measured resources and SHA-bound server-local backup/native-restore evidence.

rows.method_setting: Native TUNA mechanism with user-requested 20 image epochs; not native image-budget reproduction.

resources.inference_invocation_count_scope: Derived from unchanged native _eval_cnn branches, not a profiler measurement

resources.measurement_scope: Stage totals retain original prefix timers. Raw wall/peak cover only the resumed segment; no complete-lineage runtime or matched-compute claim.
resources.execution_scope: Resumed segment only, measured by the unchanged runner after checkpoint restoration.
resources.gpu_peak_scope: Resumed process only; earlier-process peaks are not reconstructed.

interrupted_work.scope: Lower bound from retained completed epoch/stage regions after the saved checkpoint; overlapping bounds use max, not sum. Unrecorded/incomplete work is unknown.
